== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|[[sacred artist|Sacred artist]]'s robes are specialized garments worn by practitioners of the [[sacred arts]]. These clothes serve various functions, ranging from simple attire for teachers and messengers to elaborate, multi-layered formal wear used by high-ranking individuals or for important social greetings. The robes often feature specific colors, intricate embroidery, or symbols that denote a practitioner's affiliation with a particular clan, sect, or organization. For example, some robes display family crests like the [[Arelius family|Arelius]] symbol, while others feature emblems such as a red turtle, a twin star, or a red moon. Beyond their aesthetic and symbolic roles, these garments possess practical properties. They are typically constructed from sturdy materials and benefit from the wearer's inherent spiritual protection, making them more resistant to damage during combat than standard clothing. While they are generally durable, extreme circumstances or powerful attacks can leave them tattered, singed, or stained. In some instances, highly skilled practitioners may use [[Soulsmithing]] to Forge garments that appear lifelike or carry a piece of their [[Remnant]]. The style and condition of the robes can also reflect a practitioner's status, with some appearing pristine and flawless while others are weathered or worn from travel and battle.}}
